In "intramuscular corticosteroids and oral analgesics every 6 h for one month" the frequency and duration apply to the analgesics under either reading; whether they also apply to the corticosteroid is unclear.

The case text reports persistent mild exophthalmos and elevated Anti-TPO at the 3-month follow-up; Table 1 reports partial improvement with persistent mild bilateral exophthalmos and elevated Anti-TPO at 4 months. The findings agree; only the stated time differs, and the source does not say whether these are one assessment or two (Table 1 also reports a 1-year follow-up).

Table 2 and the CAS paragraph identify patients by number ("Patients" column, "patients 1, 2, and 5", "patients 3 and 4"), not by the Case labels used in the case reports and Table 1.
